verdict.rationale: Docs confirm DNS records can be created and listed per domain, with a configurable type (A, MX, CNAME) and TTL. Community input is mixed: one user calls the interface uncluttered, while another happy registrar customer would still send people elsewhere for DNS hosting, and older threads describe a standards-breaking practice of inserting pages under customers' domains. Missing for 10: evidence of full record-type coverage (e.g. TXT, SRV, CAA, AAAA), documented minimum TTL values, first-party documentation of the DNS management UI, and recent hands-on corroboration that the DNS hosting doesn't interfere.
